title: Archive.org
description: Submit URLs to the Internet Archive Wayback Machine and save the resulting archive link.

ARCHIVEDOTORG_ENABLED.description: Submit URLs to archive.org Wayback Machine

ARCHIVEDOTORG_TIMEOUT.description: Total deadline for archive.org submission, redirects, and response reads in seconds
